issues.legal_issue: An exemption for rent proved lost and irrecoverable may be claimed in successive assessment years when the total irrecoverable rent exceeds the rent payable for one year, subject to a yearly limit equal to that year's rent.
material_facts: Income from the property was assessed on the basis of its annual value, and rent due from the tenant was later established to be irrecoverable.
The irrecoverable rent exceeded the rent payable for one year.
An exemption had already been allowed for part of the irrecoverable rent in an earlier assessment year.
The requirements for the exemption were not disputed, and the assessee sought relief for the remaining irrecoverable rent in later assessment years.
issues.conclusion: The assessee could claim exemption for the remaining irrecoverable rent in successive years, provided the deduction in any one year did not exceed the rent payable for that year.
issues.legal_principle: Section 9 of the Indian Income-tax Act, 1922, taxes property income by reference to its bona fide annual value and does not itself provide an allowance for rent that later proves irrecoverable. Under section 60, item 38 of Notification No. 878F dated March 21, 1922, exempts qualifying rent that was unpaid and proved lost and irrecoverable, subject to the stated conditions and a limit equal to one year's rent for each assessment. That annual limit does not make the exemption a one-time benefit; the remaining balance may qualify in later years. Where the language admits competing interpretations, the interpretation favourable to the assessee may be adopted. The contrary view in Daljit Singh v. Commissioner of Income-tax, Delhi, 52 I.T.R. 933, was not approved.

rule.if: property_income_tax_assessment and rent_proved_irrecoverable and irrecoverable_rent_exceeds_annual_rent and prior_partial_exemption and qualifying_exemption_conditions_met

predicates.property_income_tax_assessment: The proceeding concerns assessment of income from property on the basis of its annual value.
predicates.rent_proved_irrecoverable: The owner established that rent due from a tenant was unpaid and lost and irrecoverable.
predicates.irrecoverable_rent_exceeds_annual_rent: The total rent proved irrecoverable exceeded the rent payable for one year.
predicates.prior_partial_exemption: The owner had already received an exemption for part of the irrecoverable rent in an earlier assessment.
predicates.qualifying_exemption_conditions_met: The owner satisfied the conditions required for the exemption.

issues.definition: When property income is assessed, rent is proved irrecoverable, the total loss exceeds one year's rent, an earlier exemption covered only part of the loss, and the qualifying conditions are met, the remaining loss may be exempted in later years, subject to the yearly limit.
